title: About Mithril Metrics
text: Mithril Metrics publishes short, reproducible case studies on agri-food, climate and rural policy. Each one starts from a current policy debate, asks one narrow empirical question, and answers it with public data in about four hours.

title: About Mithril Metrics
text:
How each case is built

Public data only. Every number traces to a named dataset and access date.
One question, one answer. The bottom line comes first; caveats are stated plainly.
Methods from production and resource economics: production frontiers, productivity and efficiency measurement, risk and fat tails, panel and causal-ML econometrics.
Reproducible. All code is on GitHub and runs end to end in R.
Neutral. Policy implications are written as trade-offs, not recommendations.

title: Mithril Metrics
text:
We quantify how farms and food systems turn inputs and natural resources (land, water, nutrients, climate) into outputs, and how policy, prices and weather shocks shift that relationship, using public data and reproducible code.
Each case takes one question from a current policy debate, answers it with public data in about four hours, and publishes the code. Methods range from production frontiers and productivity decompositions to panel and causal-ML econometrics. Filter the cases by Region, Method or Theme using the categories on the right.

title: Pietro Sala
text:
I am Pietro Sala, an applied economist working on agricultural, water and resource economics. I am a PhD candidate (expected April 2027) and research associate at the Chair of Agricultural Production and Resource Economics, TUM School of Management, Technical University of Munich.
My research measures how efficiently farms and food systems use natural resources, and how to separate weather-driven losses from managerial shortfalls. Methodologically I work with stochastic frontier analysis, productivity and eco-efficiency measurement, panel econometrics and causal machine learning (double/debiased ML, LASSO). I have worked on two EU research projects: PONDERFUL (ponds as nature-based solutions) and RETOUCH NEXUS (water governance and the water–energy–food–ecosystems nexus), and I coordinate my chair’s research partnerships in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Cambodia).
